privacidad.subtitulo: Processing of personal data under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1377 of 2013.
privacidad.responsable: KHAZA, a handmade hats and clothing business based in Neiva (Huila), is responsible for the personal data collected in this store.
privacidad.datos: Name, email, phone number and the delivery address of each order.
privacidad.usoTitulo: What do we use it for?
privacidad.uso2: Recording your orders and showing you their status.
privacidad.uso3: Contacting you on WhatsApp to confirm payment and arrange shipping.
privacidad.noCompartimos: We don't sell or share your data with third parties.
privacidad.derechosIntro: As the owner of the data you can:
privacidad.derecho1: Know, update and correct your data.
privacidad.derecho2: Ask for proof of the authorization you gave us.
privacidad.derecho3: Find out how your data has been used.
privacidad.derecho4: Revoke the authorization or ask us to delete your data.
privacidad.derecho5: File complaints with the Superintendency of Industry and Commerce (SIC).
